vcs.name: 3one4 Capital
vcs.tagline: Transformative capital for the new Indian economy
vcs.description: Bengaluru-based early-stage firm founded by Pranav and Siddarth Pai, backing seed and Series A startups across fintech, SaaS/enterprise, consumer, health, media and deep tech. Backer of Licious, Darwinbox and Jupiter.

vcs.name: Accel India
vcs.tagline: Backing exceptional teams from inception onward
vcs.description: The India practice of global VC firm Accel, investing from seed through growth across SaaS, consumer internet, fintech, marketplaces and deep tech. Early investor in Flipkart, Freshworks, Swiggy and BrowserStack.

vcs.name: Alpha Wave Global
vcs.tagline: Global growth equity investor
vcs.description: Growth-equity investment firm with offices across Miami, New York, London, Abu Dhabi, Bangalore, Mumbai and New Delhi. Its India arm operates as Alpha Wave India from Indiranagar.

vcs.name: Anicut Capital
vcs.tagline: Private credit and equity for Indian entrepreneurs
vcs.description: A multi-asset investment manager running private credit (venture debt / growth finance) and equity funds, including the Grand Anicut private credit funds plus seed, growth and late-stage equity strategies.

vcs.name: Ankur Capital
vcs.tagline: Deep-tech and science-based early-stage venture capital
vcs.description: An early-stage VC backing deep-tech and science-led startups in agritech, healthcare, climate, food and enabling technologies aimed at India's next billion consumers and producers.

vcs.name: Antler India
vcs.tagline: Day-zero investing in obsessed outlier founders
vcs.description: India arm of the global day-zero VC Antler, investing at the pre-seed / pre-product stage with an AI-first focus alongside SaaS, deep tech, consumer tech and fintech. 115+ India portfolio companies.

vcs.name: Arali Ventures
